toolbar.nothingToMark: There's no phrase to mark yet.

transcript.emptyBody: Choose the spoken language and, if you like, a language to translate into. The live transcript will appear here.
transcript.label: Live transcript

status.localHint: AI models run on this Mac. No audio leaves it.
status.remoteHint: Audio is sent to {{host}} to be transcribed and translated.

settings.title: Settings
settings.uiLanguageHint: Only changes the app's interface, not the transcription languages.
settings.inputDeviceHint: Changes apply the next time you press Start.

errors.settingsLoadFailed: Couldn't load your settings. Using the defaults.
errors.noInputDevice: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
errors.inputDeviceNotFound: The selected microphone isn't connected. Choose another one in Settings › Audio.
errors.audioStreamFailed: Audio capture stopped. Check the device and try again.
errors.modelNotFound: That model isn't in the catalog.
errors.downloadFailed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again; it will resume where it stopped.
errors.modelCorrupted: The downloaded file was corrupted and has been removed. Try downloading it again.
errors.insufficientDiskSpace: There isn't enough free disk space for this model.
errors.modelNotInstalled: No model is installed. Download one in Settings › Models.
errors.llamaServerFailed: The local model couldn't start. Try again.
errors.inferenceFailed: Part of the speech couldn't be transcribed.
errors.providerNotFound: That remote server no longer exists.
errors.providerInvalid: Check the name, the URL and the model.
errors.providerInsecureUrl: Use an https:// URL. Plain http:// is only allowed for local network addresses.
errors.providerTokenMissing: Add the server's API token first.
errors.providerUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the URL and your connection.
errors.providerRejected: The server rejected the request. Check the model name and that it accepts audio.
errors.noOutputDevice: There's no audio output to capture system audio from.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside Esperanto. Try again, or restart the app.
errors.historyFailed: Couldn't read or change the history.

session.permissionBody: Allow Esperanto in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone, then press Start again.
session.noModelBody: Download a model in Settings › Models, then press Start again.
session.serverMissingBody: Esperanto runs models with llama.cpp. During development, install it with Homebrew and press Start again:
session.usingDefaultInput: The selected microphone isn't connected, so the system default is being used.
session.systemSilentBody: Nothing is playing, or Esperanto isn't allowed to record system audio. If something is playing, allow Esperanto in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording (System Audio Recording Only), then stop and start again.

models.licenseNotice: The model is downloaded from Hugging Face. By downloading it you accept its license ({{license}}).
models.deleteBody: Its files are removed from this Mac. You can download it again later.

descriptions.voxtral-mini-3b-2507-q4km: Mistral AI's speech model: transcribes and translates in a single pass.
descriptions.campplus-voxceleb-speakers: 3D-Speaker's voice print model: tells speakers apart for the speaker labels.

getStarted.title: Welcome to Esperanto
getStarted.body: Esperanto transcribes and translates speech on this Mac with {{name}}, an AI model that runs locally. It needs to be downloaded once.
getStarted.stepLanguages: Choose the spoken language and, if you like, a language to translate into.
getStarted.license: The model is downloaded from Hugging Face. By downloading it you accept its license:

providers.intro: Choose where speech is transcribed and translated: on this Mac, or on a model behind your own API gateway (any OpenAI-compatible server).
providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlHint: Including the API version, e.g. /v1. HTTPS is required except for local network addresses.
providers.tokenSaved: Saved in the Keychain (type to replace it)
providers.tokenHint: Stored in the macOS Keychain; never shown again.
providers.plainHttp: This server uses plain HTTP: audio and the token travel unencrypted on your network.
providers.testOk: Connected: the model accepts audio ({{seconds}} s).
providers.deleteBody: Its settings and its token are removed. If it was in use, Esperanto goes back to the local model.
providers.appliesNextSession: Changes apply the next time you press Start.

privacy.keepHistoryHint: Save each session on this Mac so you can read it again later. Nothing is sent anywhere. Turning this off also deletes the session in progress.
privacy.deleteAllBody: Every saved session is removed from this Mac, including the one in progress. This can't be undone.

history.title: History
history.description: Your past sessions, saved only on this Mac.
history.empty: No sessions yet. They appear here when you stop listening.
history.off: History is off. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy to keep your sessions.
history.deleteBody: Its transcript is removed from this Mac. This can't be undone.

export.title: Export transcript
export.description: Save the transcript as a text or subtitle file.

speakers.settingHint: Labels each phrase with who said it, in a different color. A small AI model tells voices apart on this Mac (also with a remote engine). Applies from the next session.
speakers.needsModel: It needs the speaker model (30 MB, {{license}}), downloaded from Hugging Face.
speakers.modelMissing: Speakers aren't labeled: download the speaker model in Settings › Audio.
speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.name: Name
speakers.off: Turn on Identify speakers in Settings › Audio to see who's speaking here.
speakers.waiting: Speakers show up here as soon as they talk.
speakers.hint: Click a speaker to give them a name. Names apply to this session.

panel.momentsEmpty: Press Mark moment to save the phrase being spoken and come back to it later.
